svg.title: PagePool calls step by step
svg.text: PagePool(8): ref_counts_ and the free_ stack after each call
8 pages here; the game's pool has about 1,450, of 16 tokens each.
Amber: changed by the call; dashed: the page Allocate popped from free_.
The coloured bar under a count shows which conversations own the page; PagePool stores only the count.
every count 0; free_ filled from the highest page down, so page 0 is on top
Allocate: pop the top of free_ and give it one owner (nullopt when free_ is empty)
Retain: one more owner of a page that already has one
Release: one owner fewer; at 0 the page goes on top of free_
